rv.q: I'm glad that it was Boop! as it was well acted and a lot of fun.
'Boop!' often hit the right fun and fluffy buttons for me to have a good time.
Clearly, “Boop! The Musical” is a piece of fluff, lighthearted and fun with a message so marginal it gets lost in the colors of the lights and cotton candy of the show.

cn.t: Critics find "Boop! The Musical" a visually inventive tribute that plays with black-and-white cartoon aesthetics, though the marriage of old and new doesn't fully come together in this early touring production.
